top_choice_rationale: P001 pairs two reproduced, chemically well-understood capabilities with clean scope: Crews and Deshaies for conceiving and first demonstrating heterobifunctional degraders (the original discovery, separated from later ligand and glue refinements) and Liu alone for base editing, whose evolved adenine deaminase is a genuinely new capability. Both open unforeseen opportunities, and the three-name allocation avoids an arbitrary cut within either part. Liu alone (P006) is my fallback, since it is the cleanest single attribution.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile (Lund colleagues Somfai and Sparr sit on the committee, but no proposed laureate has a Lund or nanoscience connection)
